epics.title: Local Stack Execution and Health Verification
epics.jtbd: When testing the delivered project locally, I want to start the full stack and query a health-check endpoint, so that I can observe the real running product and its health instead of relying on build results.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase local stack deployment success rate from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: A docker-compose.yml file must be present at the repository root to start all components of the full stack.
R2: The running stack must expose a verifiable health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Create docker-compose.yml with Health Check
slices.jtbd: When implementing local execution support for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml configuration, so that the full stack can be started and verified via a health-check endpoint.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository is cloned locally, When `docker-compose up` is executed at the root, Then all necessary services start successfully without errors.
Given the stack is running, When an HTTP GET request is made to the health-check endpoint, Then a healthy status response is returned.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce manual setup steps to a single automated command

epics.title: Resolve docker-compose.yml Missing Error
epics.jtbd: When the automated runtime observation system attempts to launch the product, I want it to find the required docker-compose.yml file, so that the launch succeeds and I receive real evidence of product behavior.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce automated launch failure rate due to missing configuration from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The repository root must contain a docker-compose.yml file so the launcher can execute it.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml to Repository Root
slices.jtbd: When addressing the missing file error for this epic, I want to ensure docker-compose.yml is committed to the repository root, so that the automated launcher finds it and successfully starts the product.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh clone of the repository, When the automated launcher checks the root directory, Then it finds docker-compose.yml.
Given the file is present, When the launcher executes it, Then the stack launches without 'not found' errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase automated launch configuration discovery rate to 100%
